findings.title: Query string on /internal/status not specified
findings.problem: The design maps `GET /internal/status` to `Admission::Status` and says path parsing splits on `?`, but does not state whether `GET /internal/status?x=1` (a cache-buster or health-check query) still maps to Status.
findings.fix: Pin the rule: compare the path before `?` for the status route so `GET /internal/status?anything` yields Status, and add an example/proptest asserting admit(Get, "/internal/status?x=1") == Status.

findings.title: Authorization-header parameter ordering basis not pinned
findings.problem: The base string pins sorting on the encoded name/value (RFC 5849 §3.4.1.3.2), but the header says only 'ordered by name' without stating encoded-vs-raw. Cosmetic (OAuth does not require header ordering; the HIGH-fix test asserts order-independent multiset equality), but unpinned.
findings.fix: Add one sentence stating header pairs are ordered by encoded name for determinism only and ordering is not protocol-significant, or state the order is unspecified and tests must not assert on it.
